sources.title: Recovered Tencent front-end interview note containing the bank-card grouping prompt
Structured interview note containing the every-four-digits example
Tagged repository coding-question record for bank-card grouping
Deterministic Node validation against a non-regex linear-scan oracle

claims.text: The recovered source asks to implement bank-card-number grouping and gives every four digits plus a space as the example; it does not define input cleaning or non-digit behavior.
The exact JavaScript implementation inserts a space after a four-digit group only when at least one following digit remains, so exact multiples of four do not acquire a trailing separator.
The implementation accepts an ASCII-digit string including the empty string and explicitly rejects non-string or non-digit input rather than silently defining an unstated cleaning policy.
The deterministic fixture compares the regex implementation with a structurally different character-by-character grouping oracle for 5000 fixed-seed digit strings of lengths zero through sixty-four.
Fixed validation covers empty, shorter-than-four, exactly-four, five-digit, multiple-of-four, non-multiple-of-four, leading-zero, and invalid-input cases.

checks: no trailing space for exact groups of four
non-digit/non-string inputs are rejected under the declared contract
5000 deterministic digit strings match the linear-scan oracle

boundary_tests.case: empty, shorter-than-four, and exactly-four digit strings
boundary_tests.expected: content is preserved and no separator is added unless another group follows

boundary_tests.case: five digits and exact multiples of four
boundary_tests.expected: spaces appear only between non-empty groups and never at the end
leading zeroes are preserved because formatting stays in string semantics

boundary_tests.case: spaces, hyphens, letters, or numeric values supplied as input
boundary_tests.expected: TypeError is thrown instead of silently cleaning or coercing input

findings: The candidate preserves the narrow source contract and does not invent a silent normalization policy for pasted or malformed input.
The lookahead formulation directly addresses the trailing-separator failure mode for lengths divisible by four.
The input contract is explicit and is independently exercised with invalid strings and a non-string value.
The randomized oracle is a character-by-character implementation rather than another regular expression, reducing circular validation risk.
Leading zeroes stay in string semantics and are covered by a fixed case.
No production metric or personal project story is invented.
Required human approval remains a separate promotion gate.
